title: YARA rule authoring for artifacts
preconditions: a benign corpus for false-positive testing
steps: Extract unique strings and byte sequences with `strings`, `xxd`, and a hex editor; prefer long, specific patterns.
Write `rule name { meta: ... strings: $a = "..." condition: uint16(0) == 0x5a4d and all of them }`.
Test `yara -r rule.yar samples/` and a benign corpus; tighten until only positives match.
Scan the memory/disk image with `yara -r -s rule.yar image.raw` and record offsets.
falsifier: The rule matches benign samples or misses the known positive; it is not specific enough.
